prompt:
The man of the first and second reference pictures, with exactly his face, his warm brown eyes and his
thick dark brown wavy hair, sits at a light wooden table in the seminar room of the third reference
picture. Use the first two pictures for his face and hair only, and the third for the materials of the
room only: the same light wood, the same off-white walls, the same grey chairs. He wears a plain dark
green fine-knit crew-neck sweater over a plain white T-shirt whose collar barely shows.

He sits on the same side of the table as the camera, a little to its left, his chest and his face
turned towards the camera, as if towards the person sitting next to him. He is seen from the waist up,
in the middle of a vertical frame; the edge of the table top runs along the bottom of the picture and
his forearms rest on it, his hands loosely joined on the bare wood, empty. The top of his head sits a
hand's width under the top edge, so that his face is one of the largest things in the picture. He looks
into the lens with a warm, open smile, as a fellow candidate who is glad to plan something together.
Behind him, the off-white wall and a closed light wooden door. The soft daylight comes from the right of
the picture.

The textures of real wool, cotton, wood, skin and painted plaster, as a visitor would take it with a
good phone camera.
